source.prdTitle: HumanifyOS end-user application (HOSAppServer + TTEC Quality UI) — every module on one dependency graph (APP)

tickets.summary: Emerging issues #sec-emerging: rising topics, 8-week sparkline, sentiment, quote
tickets.why: Emerging issues (video 04:13–04:24) are the topics rising fastest week over week weighted by worsening sentiment: a `3 rising` pill, one card per topic with its delta, 8-week area chart, sentiment bar, contacts/CSAT/negative share and a representative negative quote. The section re-scopes by program and period, updates when the emerging job publishes `hos.voc.emerging.v1`, and must render an honest empty state per scope.
tickets.what:
**UI screen:** `/HOSPACK/HOS-UI/APP/ui/shots/cx-emerging.png` · `/HOSPACK/HOS-UI/APP/ui/quality-hub.html` (open the .html mock in a browser; shots are the rendered baseline)

Deliver `apps/web/quality/src/modules/voc/emerging/` + `src/api/app-voc-emerging.ts`: `useEmerging(period, program)` key `['app','voc','emerging',period,program]` → `vocEmerging` (`EmergingTopic{id, name, delta, trend, sent, vol, csat, neg, quote}[]`; first paint from `VocOverview.emerging`); `EmergingSection` (`#sec-emerging`: title `Emerging issues & trends`, pill `<n> rising`, copy `Topics rising fastest week-over-week, weighted by worsening sentiment · <scope_note>.`, `EmergingCard`: name · `+<delta>%` chip · Q-16 `TrendArea trend` (8 weeks, compact) · `SentimentStack sent` · `<vol> contacts · CSAT <csat> · <neg>% negative` · the representative negative `quote` as text; card click → `/drill/vol/topic/<name>` (Q-38); empty `No emerging issues in <program_name> for <period label>.`); frame `hos.voc.emerging.v1` → invalidate (Q-62); period + program from Q-40; mobile: cards stack one per row; `README.md`; vitest + axe.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given `/voc?period=week&program=all` (`fixtures/data/cx_emerging.json`), then the pill reads `3 rising` and the first card `Claim status / delay · +38%` with an 8-week sparkline, the sentiment bar, `3,120 contacts · CSAT 3.2 · 56% negative` and a negative quote; clicking it navigates to `/drill/vol/topic/Claim%20status%20%2F%20delay?period=week&program=all`.

Given `?program=property&period=30d` with no rising topic, then the copy `No emerging issues in Property for Last 30 days.`; given a frame `hos.voc.emerging.v1`, the list refetches and a new card appears without reload; given `trend=[]` on a card, the sparkline shows `No data` and the card still renders.

Given Ramona's session, then the section never mounts; given `vocEmerging` answering `503 {code:"upstream_unavailable"}`, the section shows the overview's `emerging` list with a `Live update unavailable` note and no retry storm (one retry).
Given the axe sweep on the section with three cards, then zero violations: each sparkline has `role=img` with `aria-label` `<name>, 8 weeks, +38%` and the quote is a `<blockquote>`.

Given the screen rendered at 1440×900 against the msw data, then the emerging section matches (pill, copy, three cards with delta chips, sparklines, sentiment bars, stats and quotes) and the render matches `/HOSPACK/HOS-UI/APP/ui/shots/cx-emerging.png` within the ≤ 5 % perceptual-diff tolerance X-10 uses (fonts / anti-aliasing, Q-8); every string of the DOM dump `/HOSPACK/HOS-UI/APP/ui/shots/text/cx-emerging.txt` that belongs to this ticket's elements is present in the DOM.

Test command: `pnpm --filter quality test -- voc/emerging` exits 0 — vitest + testing-library against the Q-60 msw handlers generated from `fixtures/data` (the UI's local data mode): no BFF process, no browser, no Playwright.

technicalDetails.implementerNotes: The emerging rule (WoW delta weighted by sentiment shift) runs server-side (`cx_emerging.json` rule + lists per period × program; the ops route `POST /v1/_ops/emerging/run` triggers it in live mode); the UI never ranks. Quotes are anonymized server text rendered as text. The sparkline is Q-16's `TrendArea` in compact mode (no axis labels).

releaseNotes.title: Emerging issues
releaseNotes.description: Rising-topic cards with sparkline, sentiment, stats and a representative quote, scoped by program and period.

environment.name: ci
environment.testData: fixtures/data/cx_emerging.json (8-week series of the 3 rising topics, rule, lists per period × program); fixtures/data/cx_overview.json emerging

userInterface.accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA: keyboard for every control, visible focus rings on the kale palette, aria-live for score changes and toasts, contrast ≥ 4.5:1 (ink on cream), reduced-motion respected for arcs/bars; axe in vitest (Q-65 sweeps every route)

neverLog: transcript text or quotes (redacted or not)
logging.retention: 30 days in Datadog; debug not shipped in prod
